why_agent_cannot: enter an email and click the confirmation link
what_human_must_do: Enter your email and click the confirmation link in your inbox.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Read the airdrop claim announcement Open the DGrid post on the DGAI claim , which announces that the airdrop claim has started.

2 Step 2 : Check your eligibility on the official portal The announcement says the eligibility check and the claim are done on DGrid's official portal. No direct portal address is given here, so look for it in the announcement itself. If you qualify, complete the claim there.
3 Step 3 : Open AI Arena Go to the DGrid AI Arena , the community's blind model comparison area.
4 Step 4 : Earn points through Arena activities Take part in the Arena's activities to earn points. DGrid has not listed which activities earn points.

5 Step 5 : Redeem points for DGAI The Points-to-DGAI announcement says points earned in Arena activities can be redeemed for DGAI. No redemption steps or rate are stated. Read the DGAI documentation for what the token does.
